svg.title: Every pattern, one glyph
svg.desc: A specimen sheet of the twenty-four pattern icons, laid out six to a row and captioned with the pattern each one names. Every icon is the same rounded square. Inside it a glyph is drawn from three marks only: an open amber stroke for the thing the pattern is about, a solid green fill for what the store guarantees, and a faint dashed outline for what is absent, refused or merely claimed. The sheet is also the preset the individual pattern figures copy their header from.

text.tspan: A Role Is a Period on
